intents.title: CPU / device temperature
intents.command_root: for z in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*; do echo "$(cat $z/type): $(cat $z/temp)"; done
intents.explain: Shows thermal sensor readings from Android's thermal service.
intents.android_note: On Android 16 the thermal sysfs files are often unreadable even for the shell user; the thermal service output is tried first. Which zone is the CPU is device-specific.

intents.title: Battery status
intents.explain: Shows charge level, temperature and health from the battery service.

intents.title: Disk usage
intents.explain: Shows used and free space per filesystem.

intents.title: Memory usage
intents.explain: Shows total, used and free RAM.

intents.title: Magisk modules
intents.explain: Lists installed Magisk modules. Needs root.
intents.android_note: KernelSU and APatch keep modules in different places.

intents.title: Root check
intents.command_user: ls -d /system/bin/su /system/xbin/su /sbin/su /debug_ramdisk/su 2>/dev/null || true; type su 2>/dev/null || echo 'no su on PATH'
intents.explain: Looks for common su locations without asking for root. The root variant runs id and should print uid=0.
intents.android_note: Say 'as root' only if you want to actually request root; your root manager may show a prompt.

intents.title: IP addresses
intents.explain: Lists the IPv4 addresses on this phone's network interfaces.
intents.android_note: Newer Android versions may hide 'ip addr' from apps; the command then falls back to ifconfig. This only shows local addresses and sends nothing over the network.

intents.title: Running processes
intents.android_note: Without root, Android only shows this app's processes.

intents.title: Android version
intents.command_user: echo "Android $(getprop ro.build.version.release) (SDK $(getprop ro.build.version.sdk)), security patch $(getprop ro.build.version.security_patch)"
intents.explain: Reads the Android release, SDK level and security patch date from system properties.

intents.title: Kernel version
intents.explain: Prints the kernel name, release and build string.

intents.title: Device model
intents.explain: Reads the manufacturer, model and device name from system properties.

intents.title: CPU details
intents.command_user: grep -m1 -E 'Hardware|model name' /proc/cpuinfo; echo "cores: $(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"; uname -m
intents.explain: Shows the CPU name when available, the number of cores and the architecture.

intents.title: Uptime
keywords: how long has my phone been on
intents.explain: Shows how long the phone has been running since its last boot.

intents.title: Termux environment info
intents.explain: Prints details about this Termux install and device for bug reports.
